preferred_realization: finite multiset or finite divisor of bounded nontrivial zeros
lean_targets: NontrivialZero : ℂ -> Prop (or bind existing predicate)
zeroMultiplicity : ℂ -> ℕ (or existing order-of-zero API)
formal_risks: Zero sets of holomorphic functions are not represented naively as finite sets without a finiteness theorem.
Multiplicity requires order-of-vanishing data, not duplicate complex values in a Finset.
The formal RiemannHypothesis predicate may quantify zeros in a representation different from this contract.
Boundary zeros at Im(rho)=T must not cause count discontinuity ambiguity in equivalence proofs.
fallback_realizations: zero counting measure/divisor restricted to compact rectangle
argument-principle count attached to a contour with boundary-zero guard
abstract finite multiset theorem first, analytic binding second
